description: Attributable fractions refitted on 2022-2024 only and with police-reported alcohol (three codings), next to the published 2016-2024 imputed-alcohol fractions
method: g-computation with survey logistic model A; AF = (observed - counterfactual predicted)/observed; linearised CI; for the fatal outcome only, FARS-scaled = AF x mean annual FARS fatal crashes (or deaths) 2022-2024, assuming the averted fatal crashes carry the average number of deaths per fatal crash; fractions of KA crashes are not scaled; variants: model period 2016-2024 or 2022-2024, alcohol NHTSA-imputed or police-reported (unknown as a level, dropped, or as no); deaths scaling always uses the 2022-2024 FARS means; intervals cover sampling only
